What makes it unique

Blemishes, uneven texture and dullness need active care that does not overwhelm the skin. 10% Niacinamide fades pigmentation and visibly brightens. Rice Water smooths texture, while olive-derived Squalane boosts hydration and supports the barrier.

How to use

Begin with a freshly cleansed face. Take 3 to 4 drops onto your palm or directly onto your face. Dab gently across the face and let it air dry before following with moisturiser. Use morning and night.

The science, the formula and the routine.

Where the marks actually come from

An acne mark is not a scar. It is pigment left behind after the inflammation settles, when melanin gets transferred into the surrounding skin cells. Clear the pigment transfer and the mark fades on its own.

10% NIACINAMIDE
Inhibits the transfer of melanin to skin cells, so dark spots and post-acne pigmentation visibly reduce.
RICE WATER EXTRACT
Smooths texture and holds hydration, so the surface reflects light evenly instead of looking dull.

What that looks like on your face

Brightness shows up immediately because hydration lifts the surface. The pigment work takes longer: marks visibly lighten across the first fortnight, and tone keeps evening out after that.

36-user study at an independent, expert-graded lab. 97% experienced reduced blemishes.

Questions people ask

If yours is not here, reach us on 1800 or +91 750-649-6604, or write to hello@plumgoodness.com.

What are the benefits of a Rice Water & 10% Niacinamide serum?

It combines the brightening and blemish-fading properties of Niacinamide with the smoothing and hydrating properties of rice water. Expect brighter skin from the first use and 2x instant hydration. In two weeks you can also expect reduced blemishes and smoother skin, all in a lightweight, non-sticky milky texture.

How do I fit this into my routine?

After cleansing and toning, apply a few drops to your face and neck and massage in gently. Follow with a moisturiser, and sunscreen in the morning. It works in both the AM and PM routine.

Will it help with dark spots, acne scars and uneven tone?

Yes. Niacinamide works by inhibiting the transfer of melanin to skin cells, which reduces the appearance of dark spots and hyperpigmentation over time.

Is it suitable for beginners or sensitive skin?

Yes. Niacinamide is one of the gentler actives, which makes it well suited to beginners and sensitive skin. The formula is also enriched with Squalane and Licorice, which maintain a healthy barrier while reducing redness and inflammation.

Can I use it with Vitamin C or Retinol?

Yes. Niacinamide is compatible with most actives including Vitamin C and low-dose Retinol. Introduce them gradually and watch how your skin responds. Always patch test on the inside of your arm first.
